label: Diagram 1
caption: Diagram 1 Drainage field
description: This diagram, titled "Diagram 1 Drainage field", is an axometric view of an underground drainage field with a vertical cross-section on the right. On the left, a tank labelled "Septic tank—either glass fibre thermoplastics or precast concrete" connects by a pipe to a cylindrical structure labelled "Distribution/sampling chamber". From there a rectangular loop of pipes runs across a grey rectangular area, these being labelled "Perforated effluent distribution pipes". Two double-headed arrows between the parallel pipe runs are each marked "Minimum 2m separation". On the right, a cut block of ground with grass on top shows layered construction. The labels, read from top to bottom, read "Selected soil backfill", "Geotextile membrane", "Perforated effluent distribution pipe" (shown in section), and "Graded 30–50mm granular material". Dimension arrows at the left of the block give "50mm" for the upper portion and "300mm" for the lower portion.
